findings.description: The KMS key does not set enable_key_rotation to true, so automatic annual rotation is disabled (the AWS default). A symmetric key that is never rotated keeps a compromised or exfiltrated key material valid indefinitely, weakening the confidentiality of all data encrypted under this key over its lifetime.
